facts.text: The upstream README contains only the project title and no usage, unit, range or safety text
The package exports Drone and DroneManager from pysimverse.simulators.drone
The Drone constructor takes host='*', cmd_port=5550, state_port=5556, video_port=5557, speed=300 and rotation_speed=15
The constructor sets command_address to tcp://{host}:{cmd_port}, state_address to tcp://localhost:{state_port} and video_address to tcp://localhost:{video_port}
connect() binds the command socket, connects and subscribes the state and video sockets and sleeps 0.25 s
send_rc_control publishes a JSON object with left_right, forward_backward, up_down, yaw, cameraangle, streamon and a red/green/blue color object
send_rc_control catches every exception, prints it and returns, so a failed publish has no error value
streamon and streamoff assign self.stream_on and publish it with all motion axes None
Each move_* method acts only while is_flying is true, otherwise it prints 'Take off the drone first.'
move_forward publishes the current speed on the forward axis, sleeps distance / speed and then publishes a zero command
move_backward, move_right, move_left, move_up and move_down mirror move_forward with the opposite sign or another axis
take_off sets is_flying true, publishes takeoff_speed on the up axis, sleeps takeoff_height / takeoff_speed and then publishes a zero command
land publishes -landing_speed on the up axis, sleeps 3 s, publishes a zero command and sets is_flying false
rotate publishes rotation_speed / 70 on the yaw axis with the sign of the angle, sleeps abs(angle / 60) and then publishes a zero command
rotate_camera publishes the angle as cameraangle, sleeps abs(angle / 40) and then publishes a zero command
set_speed and set_rotation_speed assign their argument to the corresponding attribute
get_battery receives and prints the state message, parses it as a float and sleeps 1 s, but never returns the parsed value and catches only KeyboardInterrupt
get_frame calls self.fpsReader.update when a frame is available
get_frame catches exceptions, prints the error and returns frame and is_success
shutdown closes the command, state and video sockets, terminates the context and calls cv2.destroyAllWindows
DroneManager.create_drones connects, publishes the drone count, reads a port list and constructs one Drone per port
DroneManager.takeoff_all_drones starts one thread per drone and calls take_off with 300

determinism.notes: the fake is a deterministic command recorder with no time advance and no randomness; one call sequence always gives the same recorded commands

gaps: the checked fake is an in-memory command recorder, not the upstream ZMQ simulator peer: it sends no traffic, models no flight dynamics, position, battery, video, wind or timing, and was never compared with the simulator that the clone's PUB/SUB client expects

the upstream methods sleep for the duration computed from distance/speed, height/speed, abs(angle/60), abs(angle/40) or 3 s for land (drone.py:169, 224, 234, 248, 256); the fake returns immediately and records only the command pair
the clone ships no simulator server, so the live peer, pyzmq, OpenCV and NumPy dependencies and the recorded F0 timing were not run
get_battery (drone.py:152-164) never returns its parsed value, so battery telemetry is not covered
get_frame (drone.py:104-139) calls an undefined fpsReader but catches the exception and may return a frame with is_success already true; video capture is not covered
DroneManager's handshake and fleet takeoff (drone_manager.py:41-116) are not covered by this package
the fake does not simulate the native time.sleep, so an action's wall-clock duration is not modelled
zero RC is an unacknowledged request, not a confirmed stop; send_rc_control suppresses errors and the clone contains no simulator-side consumer; the package is blocked with HELPER_MISSING
native methods print to stdout, which would interfere with a stdio endpoint; live construction opens ZeroMQ sockets and shutdown can wait on socket/context cleanup; no live factory is declared

operator_required.name: speed
operator_required.reason: the clone states no RC speed range: the constructor only sets speed=300 (drone.py:11), set_speed assigns its argument unchanged (drone.py:261-262) and the motion methods divide the distance by it; the site sets the bound

operator_required.name: rotation_speed
operator_required.reason: the clone states no rotation-speed range: the constructor only sets rotation_speed=15 (drone.py:11) and set_rotation_speed assigns its argument unchanged (drone.py:264-265); the site sets the bound

operator_required.name: takeoff
operator_required.reason: the clone states no takeoff-height range: take_off takes takeoff_height with a constructor-style default and computes takeoff_height / takeoff_speed (drone.py:220-225); the site sets the bound

operator_required.name: takeoff
operator_required.reason: the clone states no takeoff-speed range: take_off takes takeoff_speed and divides the height by it (drone.py:220-225); the site sets the bound

operator_required.name: land
operator_required.reason: the clone states no landing-speed range: land takes landing_speed and sends it as the down axis (drone.py:231-237); the site sets the bound

operator_required.name: move
operator_required.reason: the clone states no distance range: every move_* method divides distance by the current speed to get a sleep duration (drone.py:166-171); the site sets the bound

operator_required.name: rotate
operator_required.reason: the clone states no angle range: rotate divides the angle by 60 for its sleep and uses rotation_speed / 70 as the yaw value (drone.py:241-249); the site sets the bound

operator_required.name: rotate_camera
operator_required.reason: the clone states no camera-angle range: rotate_camera sends the angle as cameraangle and divides it by 40 for its sleep (drone.py:253-257); the site sets the bound

safe_state.description: unconfirmed: a zero RC publish is attempted, but the clone supplies no acknowledgement or stopped-state read-back and suppresses send errors; the latch refuses new commands, while the external simulator may continue moving; e-stop reports SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED and recovery requires a reviewed stop/confirmation path outside this package
